column1: # ui hud batch (GlErrorChecker / GroupBar / ResultBanner / TimeStatusBar / OkDialog / MinimapPanel)
# GlErrorChecker: a() reads glGetError and logs the symbolic name, defaulting the location to
#   "unknown" -> check() ; the String overload reports that location -> check(String).
# GroupBar: k = the expanded/collapsed flag, l = the selected group index. a() collapses the bar
#   (y back to 8, frame hidden, selection cleared) -> collapse ; b() expands it -> expand ;
#   a(int) raises the given group button and shows its frame -> selectGroup ; c() reads the
#   selection -> getSelectedGroup ; d() refreshes every slot (style by domain, unit count label,
# ResultBanner: a = the victory flag; a(boolean) swaps the two banner regions and recentres the
#   icon -> setVictory ; a() -> isVictory ; a(int,int) packs and applies the banner width
# TimeStatusBar: the two labels are formatted through TextFormatter, one from a long (the match
#   clock) -> setGameTime, one from a float (a resource total) -> setResourceAmount.
# OkDialog: a(String) writes the same text into both outline labels (the title) -> setTitle ;
#   b(String) fills the scrolled body -> setMessage.
# MinimapPanel: a()/a(boolean) switch between the expanded and collapsed containers
#   -> isExpanded/setExpanded ; b(boolean)/c(boolean) enable the two zoom buttons (data 101/102)
